Name: Combine Many Rings
Author: SlivaStari
Description:
A simple mod to allow to Forge multiple rings together instead of just two.

Still requires that each ring combined is unique, you cannot put two rings that are the same, even if combined into other rings. Unforging will only break apart the most recently combined rings. The cost to combine remains 20 Cinder Shards.

Optionally adds a [b]Balanced Mode[/b], based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8981/]BalancedCombineManyRings[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9527059]felipearrudapontes[/url] / Arruda[b]:[/b]
[list]
[*]In Balanced Mode, rings cost more to combine based on the total number of rings in the new ring, with a default of 100. This scales up to 999 shards.
[*]In Balanced Mode, rings may also have a risk of breaking with a default of 20% chance per ring. This scales up to a 90% chance of failure.
[/list]
In Balanced Mode with the default configurations, this is the expected behavior of combining more than two rings in the forge::

[list]
[*]Combining 2 Rings - Default cost and behavior
[*]Combining 3 Rings - cost of 100 Cinder Shards and 20% of chance of failing the forge
[*]Combining 4 Rings - cost of 200 Cinder Shards and 40% of change of failing the forge
[*]Combining 6 Rings - cost of 400 Cinder Shards and 80% of change of failing the forge
[*]Combining 7 Rings - cost of 500 Cinder Shards and 90% of change of failing the forge
[*]Combining 12 Rings - cost of 999 Cinder Shards and 90% of change of failing the forge
[/list]
Optionally, the same ring may be combined with itself by setting the [b]Allow Same Ring[/b] configuration option. This is even more overpowered.
Should be compatible with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214/]WearMoreRings[/url] [/b]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7515]Skill Rings[/url] Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8824]Many Enchantments[/url].[b]
[/b]
For an alternate progress system check out  [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10669]Ring Overhaul[/url][/b]. You can't use both together.

Source Code [url=https://github.com/SlivaStari/CombineManyRings]Here[/url]. Supports GenericModConfigurationMenu.
